reference_model.name: validated nested sequential reference
reference_model.note: Prior validated benchmark. v0.9 operational reproduction is reported separately.

notes.recipe_baseline: Empirical nominal baseline from training lots because the dataset does not contain broad recipe variation.
notes.mean_model: Strict leave-one-date/lot-out Ridge on cached Process features; fixed sequential correction starts after two prior measured wafers.
notes.oes: Process+OES cold model is evaluated separately. Positive OES incremental RMSE means OES reduced RMSE.
notes.spatial_model: Target is point etch minus wafer mean. Strict held-out-lot validation. Full model uses XY/radius/angle geometry, available preox, wafer order, Process and OES.
notes.preox: Available preox is used as a pre-process feature, but much of the 89-point field is interpolated from the original sparse preox measurement.
